text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "A Banquet Dedicated to the Fanatics"—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All who gather today worship their 
respective idols— and crave to be driven 
further into madness...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—What incredible eccentricity! I like 
you!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just imagine. If all that madness were to 
become entirely mine... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Today! I shall... establish the Gimlet 
Empire right here at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kukukuk... BWAHAHAHAHA--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival, an event to 
express gratitude to the fans who support 
us. It all began with Tanino Gimlet's 
terrifying ambition.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: “—Why do you only gaze at the lake, Leda?”

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Are you talking to me...? Um, I'm 
just looking outside, though...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
There may be peace on an unrippled lake's 
surface. However, you do not know.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The joy! The shock of being swept away by 
a raging storm! —...Shall I teach it to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
My heart skipped a beat...! I don't really 
get it, but it's so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, she started by winning over every 
person she encountered—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I'm a little tired. When 
there're this many people around... phew."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Why cower before phantoms? A haven 
of rest is something you must reach with 
your own two legs—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you're willing to stand, I'll lend you 
a hand. —Shall we begin our getaway?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Thump-thump! Lord Gim...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Do you crave excitement? Then follow me! 
I shall guide you all... straight to my 
Empyrean!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Lord Giiiiim~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the number of fans captivated by 
Tanino Gimlet steadily grew—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOHHH...!! LORD GIMLET.........!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Kuh-haha! Fuh-hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that very scream is what I sought! 
Come... the time is ripe. Scream with all 
your might!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What do you demand of an idol?! 
Destruction? Domination? ...Or further 
intoxication?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An eruption—the fervor reaches its 
absolute peak, and wordless roars burst 
forth. The frenzy of the excited 
spectators is nothing short of pure 
madness—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOHH...! OOH... OOOOOHHH...!
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should put a stop to this 
soon...!)

text_block_list.name: Fans?
text_block_list.text: Ramen!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Whoever just said... "ramen"! Come 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's me♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... I knew it was you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O courageous lady. Why do you dare ask an 
idol for ramen?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am no decorative king. If I were to say 
I wanted the sky, I would bring it down, 
would I not?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My gentle dictator. My only wish is to be 
of help to you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to eat ramen. Along with 
everyone else... okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm... Hoh. A sea of brown and soft 
wheat, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Such a gentle flavor... It's so 
comforting...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Soy sauce ramen also has the effect 
of calming the soul, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you look with a heart as clear as soup, 
you will surely see your own charm much 
better.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Cast aside the madness, and 
reflect love in one's heart... you say."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I cannot agree with that. However, I will 
back down for now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A conductor who cannot keep madness in 
check is not worthy of being called a 
king.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am... merely the Princess's 
hanger-on. I shall simply savor the 
ramen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'Gimlet Empire' failed to rise... Its 
madness dissolved and drifted away into 
the warm steam.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
INTOXICATION!! DOMINATION!! DESTRUCTION!! 
GRRRROOOOAAAAR...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer momentum of the fans looks ready 
to cause an avalanche at any moment...! 
Egging them on any further would be far 
too dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Tsk, tsk, tsk.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, Trainer. What is needed is not 
restraint.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It's a stage.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think I incited madness 
without cause? Heh heh... Just watch. 
Watch as the boundaries melt away!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Gwooo... Rummmble...! Inebriation! 
Inebriation! Inebriation! Inebriation...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —O people! Your idol is here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Capturing the fans' attention in an 
instant, Tanino Gimlet began to speak. Her 
presence was like that of a statesman 
standing at the podium—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Ask, and it shall be given you! You all 
have already fulfilled that condition!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
More intoxication, more thrill! I promise 
you! To every ego out there, a sweet 
nightmare!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Today! I! Hereby— Proclaim the founding of 
the 'Gimlet Empire'!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single fan was applauding. Tanino 
Gimlet's speech had united the tremendous 
passion of the crowd into one.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let me first introduce my loyal 
strategist, who will build this empire 
alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer, forward!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, don't flinch! Your subjects are 
waiting for――
HEEEEEEEY!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's far enough, Gimlet! Disturbing the 
peace at the Fan Appreciation Festival is 
strictly forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Occupying the track, inciting the fans. 
Holding an unauthorized gathering...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, don't cause a scene during an 
important event. Especially on such a 
scale...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! A coalition of the Disciplinary 
Committee and Student Council, is it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Disband, we're disbanding-!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. What on earth am I doing 
here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I was having a dream... 
L-Let's head back...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the crude shouting has sobered me 
up... has it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It was just one push away from 
"perfection," too. Fufu... well, no 
matter.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The seeds have been sown. With just a pour 
of water, my empire can be revived at any 
moment...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kukukuk... BWAHAHAHAHA!
